description: This file contains MIPS assembly code for configuring and setting the SRAM clock rates on Realtek RTL839X chips. It includes definitions for setting clock rates, managing clock sources, and controlling hardware registers related to SRAM clock configurations.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_start
methods.description: Label marking the start of SRAM clock configuration code.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the SRAM clock rate based on input parameters for clock source configuration.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_size
methods.description: Symbol representing the size of the SRAM, referencing the start label.
